dataset: BDS -- a public data set of human balance evaluations (Santos & Duarte 2016)
citation: Santos DA, Duarte M. A public data set of human balance evaluations. PeerJ 2016;4:e2648. doi:10.7717/peerj.2648.
record: force-plate COP (COPx/COPy) at 100 Hz, 60 s quiet standing; 2x2 vision (open/closed) x surface (firm/foam) design
selection: 158 subjects who completed all four vision x surface conditions (complete blocks). Per subject-condition: mean COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) across trials.
